Tomorrow is Juneteenth (market closed) — today is the last session before a 3-day weekend with Hormuz implementation news flowing in real time.

bear_case: The June 18 equity gap-up is geopolitical relief, not a change in the rate path: nine FOMC officials project rate hikes, the 2026 median stands at 3.8%, and retail sales at +0.9% with CPI at 4.2% give the Fed statistical justification to follow through on those dots. The June CPI print (expected early July) is the next inflection — if it comes in above 4.0%, the 30Y breaches 5.00% and VIX closes above 20 in the same session, converting HOLD to STEP_ASIDE immediately. The Juneteenth 3-day weekend carries asymmetric Hormuz risk: mine-clearance timelines, Iranian domestic opposition, or sanctions-removal logistics could generate a deal-credibility gap over the weekend with no US market to absorb it — Monday June 22 could open with both Iran reversal risk and the FOMC hawkish regime still intact, a double-negative targeting SPX 7,300–7,350. If today's session fails to close above 7,460 despite the Iran gap-up, a two-session distribution pattern (7,548 June 16 → 7,420 June 17 → failed recovery June 18) establishes a bearish double-top. If SPX closes above 7,460 today AND VIX closes below 18 AND DXY falls below 99.00 on the same close, HOLD upgrades to BUY immediately going into June 22.
